verdict.rationale: Trello's own Power-Up framework lets developers add UI that renders inside Trello: card badges, card-back buttons, board buttons, and attachment sections. The docs say some Power-Ups provide "a new view into the data you have stored in cards," and a community member describes building a custom Power-Up. However, the evidence shows only these small embedded UI surfaces, not full custom views or dashboard widgets, and nothing on making extensions look native. missing for 10: documented custom board-level views or dashboard widget surfaces, native styling/design-system guidance for extensions, and independent hands-on evidence that custom UIs feel native.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build custom views and dashboard widgets that feel native to the product

citations.quote: With Power-Ups you can add buttons to cards and boards, show previews of attachments on Trello cards, and much more - all inside of Trello!
